h1: Heaven Hotel Chachoengsao — A New In-Town Stay in Paet Riu With Clean Rooms, Near Wat Sothon
intro: If you're in Paet Riu (Chachoengsao) to pay respects to Luang Pho Sothon and want somewhere new, clean, affordable, and easy to park — Heaven Hotel Chachoengsao is the name leading the review scores in town. This 3-star hotel opened in 2020 with 71 rooms, sitting on Chachoengsao-Bang Pakong Road in the Na Mueang subdistrict. The building is still new, rooms are kept clean, staff are helpful, and rates start from around ฿790/night — which is why it scores surprisingly high for a small-town hotel.

body.html: What drives Heaven Hotel's high review score is how new and clean it feels. The hotel only opened in 2020, so the building and rooms are still in good shape. Guests repeatedly say the rooms are very clean, well kept, the beds comfortable, and there's none of the musty smell you get from many older hotels in town. For a stay in the low-hundreds-to-low-thousands baht range in a small city like Paet Riu, that level of freshness isn't easy to find.

The hotel sits on Chachoengsao-Bang Pakong Road in the Na Mueang subdistrict — just a few minutes' drive to Wat Sothon Wararam and within easy reach of the town center, market, and the riverside restaurants along the Bang Pakong. Parking is free with room to spare, which matters to anyone arriving by car. One thing to note: Chachoengsao train station is about 5 km away, so if you come by rail you'll need to grab a ride into the hotel.

There's a range of room types, from Superior and Deluxe up to Family rooms and a suite. Rooms come with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, and the basic amenities, and some have a small balcony with a town view. Hot water works well, and the common areas include a lounge, garden, and terrace to sit out in. The front desk is open 24 hours, with luggage storage and laundry service on hand.
"New room, very clean, friendly and helpful staff, easy parking, and just a short drive to pay respects to Luang Pho Sothon — great value for the price."

To be honest, there are a few things to brace for. The entry-level rooms are on the small side, and some balconies are so tiny they're barely usable. A point that comes up often in reviews is that some bathrooms have no shower partition, so the whole floor gets wet after you shower. Breakfast is simple with limited choices — most guests say it's enough to tide you over but don't expect a big buffet.

Overall, Heaven Hotel scores 9.2 out of 10 on Trip.com from 129 reviews, which is very high for a hotel in Chachoengsao town. TripAdvisor scores are more mixed, a reminder that your experience can depend on which room you get. But measured on freshness, cleanliness, free parking, a location that's a quick drive to Wat Sothon, and rates that start around ฿790 and climb into the low thousands by season and room type — it does the job nicely as a base for temple visits, a stopover, or a business trip on a friendly budget.

honestSummary: Heaven Hotel is the right pick for anyone who wants a new, clean stay in Paet Riu that's a quick drive to Wat Sothon — well-kept rooms, free parking, helpful staff, in the hundreds-to-low-thousands baht range. The trade-offs are small entry-level rooms and a few bathroom quirks to be ready for.
honestChecks: If you want a roomy space for a multi-night stay — the entry-level rooms are on the small side → step up to a Deluxe or Family room for more comfort.
If you dislike a wet bathroom floor — some rooms have no shower partition → ask for a room with a partition, or be prepared for a wet floor after showering.
If you arrive by train — Chachoengsao station is about 5 km away → budget for a ride in, or pick a stay near the station if you don't have a car.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Heaven Hotel Chachoengsao

faq.q: Where is Heaven Hotel in Chachoengsao · is it near Wat Sothon?
faq.a: Heaven Hotel is at 259/1 Chachoengsao-Bang Pakong Road, Na Mueang subdistrict, in central Chachoengsao. It's just a few minutes' drive to Wat Sothon Wararam, and within easy reach of the town center, market, and the Bang Pakong riverside. Chachoengsao train station is about 5 km away.

faq.q: How much is Heaven Hotel · what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿790/night for a Superior room. Choices run from Superior and Deluxe to Family rooms and a suite. Prices rise into the low thousands by season and room type, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is Heaven Hotel a new hotel · are the rooms clean?
faq.a: It's a fairly new hotel, opened in 2020. The thing real reviews praise most is how new and clean the rooms are, well kept with comfortable beds. It scores 9.2 out of 10 on Trip.com from 129 reviews — high for a hotel in Chachoengsao town.
Yes · free on-site parking, which suits self-drivers. It matters here because most visitors come by car to pay respects at Wat Sothon and tour around Paet Riu.

faq.q: What are the bathrooms like at Heaven Hotel?
faq.a: Bathrooms have hot water and basic amenities, but some rooms have no shower partition, so the floor gets wet after you shower. If you'd rather avoid a wet bathroom, ask at booking or check-in for a room with a partition.

faq.q: Who is Heaven Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for temple visitors coming for Luang Pho Sothon, travelers passing through, or business trips in Paet Riu who want a new, clean room with parking at a friendly price. It's not about luxury, but it's clean and complete enough for a night or two.
